current_admission_assessment.reason: Five pre-cutoff listed-consolidated cement issuers provide source-bearing business, control, recurring D2 and five-year D3/D4 disclosure histories. H1 establishes disclosure intake only; action-specific transport radius, delivered-price and customer-market overlap remain open for H2.

universe.membership_rule: Five listed cement issuers were selected before any action search because their cutoff-before annual reports disclose recurring issuer-level product-volume fields, consolidated financial statements, and a source-bearing distinct ultimate-control record.

competitive_arena.product_or_service_scope: Cement and clinker supplied through issuer-consolidated production and distribution assets; product and customer response are evaluated within the relevant delivered market rather than by issuer province labels.
competitive_arena.geographic_scope: Multiple regional delivered markets linked to plant, terminal and customer locations; geographic equality is not an H1 gate.
competitive_arena.customer_end_market_scope: Construction, infrastructure and property customers served through regional cement/clinker channels; action-specific transport radius, delivered-price and customer overlap are reserved for H2.
